title: David and Goliath
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart, and tonight a shepherd boy faces a giant in the name of the Lord: Beau says a little prayer and jumps into the deep end at his first swim lesson.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because facing something big takes a big heart. In Beau’s world today: it is his first swim lesson, and the deep end looks as big as a giant. His knees shake on the edge of the pool. Beau whispers a little prayer, takes a big breath, and jumps into his teacher’s waiting arms. Just like David facing Goliath, Beau learned that you do not have to be big to be brave when you know Who is with you.
